newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan central bank eases overseas borrowing rule.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan central bank eases overseas borrowing rule.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank on Wednesday decided to let local firms borrow more money from foreign financial institutions for domestic investment, further liberalising the island's financial markets.
Until now, local enterprises could only borrow up to US$20 million from foreign financial institutions to be used for domestic investment projects.
The latest liberalisation, effective immediately, allows Taiwan firms to borrow money above the $20 million cap with the approval of related state agencies, a central bank statement said.
"The relaxation will give local businesses more flexibility for the use of funds," the statement said.
